page.overview:
Who is Basch?

Basch is a playable character in Final Fantasy XII. He is a Knight-like physical-geared character by his stat growth: strong and resilient. He appears in the prologue as a support character and later as a guest, eventually becoming the fourth permanent character to join the party.

Basch has the highest HP growth of all playable characters, and is tied with Vaan for the highest Strength. His MP growth, Vitality and Speed are the lowest of the party, and his Magick Power is low as well. Basch, alongside Vaan and Balthier, have the best combo speed with the high-combo weapons, and thus are good candidates for job combinations that exploit this in The Zodiac Age version.

Any stat differences can be made up with gear and the animation speed differences are negligible. Basch can be built in any way without drawbacks.

Basch is the only character to not speak when performing his Quickenings, only letting out various grunts and cries. He is the only one shown using a Quickening in a fixed scene (Prologue). He has the most party member character models, from his Dalmascan suit of armor as a knight, to disgraced prisoner, to clothes pilfered from a dead man, to his final Bhujerban-inspired get-up with which he joins as a permanent party member. After winning a boss battle, the currently alive members of the active party perform a victory pose depending on what weapon they are equipped with.
